title: JS NDE 3773
content: After being sent to the hospital, my body felt peaceful and amazing. I felt my body being separated from my own self. I drifted toward the ceiling, and the monitor line went flat. I saw unearthly beings, but they looked as if they were not trying to hurt me. One minute later, a bright light fell above me. Through a pitch-black tunnel, I drifted up to that light. Near one foot before the light 'swallowed' me up, I suddenly start to fall back to my body. I call this a strange vision/dream, but it was cool.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Criminal attack 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death'
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Special Knowledge | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: The time when my body rose to the bright light.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: There were colors unimaginable that were more brilliant then the sun.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: It all sounded messed up, but it gave me a sense of heaven.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was the darkest I have ever seen.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw God, Jesus, and many deceased family members.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I'd gone to places on earth and in heaven which I haven't gone to before.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt happy and sad all at once.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw my life flash before myself, and saw things I mystically knew but did not know before.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin

elements.Have your relationships changed specific: No Nobody thought I was telling the truth when I told them I had an NDE.
